title.zh: v2.11.3 导出终于找得到了：导出是主操作而非「高级功能」，菜单也不再挂在工程面板的分支里
title.en: v2.11.3 Export Is Findable: a Primary Action, Its Menu Out of the Project Panel, and Labelled Export Rather Than MIDI

highlights.zh: **你报的「PC 和 iPad 上找不到导出 WAV/MP3」查清了，是两个各自独立的原因叠加。** ① 导出按钮在工具栏里被登记为 **Tier 2**（「高级控件」），也就是说**必须先打开高级控件它才会出现**；而且它的文字标签是 `hidden lg:inline`——1024px 以下只剩一个没有文字的下载图标。② 更隐蔽的是：这个菜单**渲染在「工程」面板那个 JSX 分支里面**，那个分支自己也有 Tier 2 守卫，而且在工具栏折叠时（手机/平板正是这种情况）**整块不渲染**——所以那些设备上导出**根本不在 DOM 里**。现在导出是 Tier 1（默认可见）、文字标签从 640px 起就显示、并拥有自己的可见性守卫；实测 iPad 竖/横（834 / 1194）与 PC 1280 / 1440 都稳定显示「导出」。
highlights.en: **Your report — can't find WAV/MP3 export on PC and iPad — turned out to be two independent causes stacked.** (1) Export was registered as a **Tier-2** toolbar control (advanced controls), so it only appeared after the user found that toggle; and its text label was `hidden lg:inline`, so below 1024 px it was an unlabelled download icon. (2) More hidden: the menu was rendered **inside the project-panel JSX branch**, which has its own Tier-2 guard *and* is skipped entirely whe…

highlights.zh: **它以前还叫「MIDI」。** 触发按钮的 `title` 用的是 i18n 键 `export`，而这个键在本应用里意思是 **MIDI**（定义在 `explore.ts`）——于是**一个含五种格式的菜单，标题却是其中一种**。这大概是「找不到」最直接的原因：谁会去点一个写着「MIDI」的按钮找 WAV？现在它有自己的一对键 `toolbar_export_menu`（导出 / Export），且所有 labelKey 又都只来自 `studio.ts`（测试里那张跨文件例外表因此清空，并保留为将来真正例外的显式位置）。
highlights.en: **It used to be called MIDI.** The trigger's `title` borrowed the i18n key `export`, which in this app means **MIDI** (it is defined in `explore.ts`) — so **a menu of five formats was titled after one of them**. That is probably the most direct reason nobody found it: who clicks something labelled MIDI looking for WAV? It has its own pair of keys now (`toolbar_export_menu`), and every labelKey resolves from `studio.ts` again (the test's cross-file exception table is therefor…

highlights.zh: **加了两个回归守卫，因为这类 bug 单看代码是看不出来的。** ① 列表层：`export` 必须在 Tier 1、必须在 `DEFAULT_VISIBLE_IDS` 里、必须不在 Tier 2/3——有人把它降级就会失败。② 渲染层（新增 `toolbarExportDiscoverability.test.tsx`）：在 `showAdvancedControls: false`（全新安装的默认状态）下挂载工具栏，断言导出入口**确实存在**且带 Tier 1 标记、可访问名不是「MIDI」而是「导出」；并有一条**结构化**断言，直接读源码确认 `<ExportMenu>` 不在 `project-hub` 守卫与它闭合括号之间——因为这次的根因就是「位置」，而渲染测试看不见「我在哪个分支里」。另外 `probe:toolbar` 的可见控件清单里现在有 `export`。
highlights.en: **Two regression guards, because this class of bug is invisible in a code review.** (1) Table level: `export` must be Tier 1, must be in `DEFAULT_VISIBLE_IDS` and must not be in Tier 2/3 — demoting it fails. (2) Render level (new `toolbarExportDiscoverability.test.tsx`): the toolbar is mounted with `showAdvancedControls: false` (a fresh install's default state) and the export entry must **exist**, carry the Tier 1 marker, and have an accessible name that is the export label…
